epochs.name: Planck epoch
epochs.summary: Gravity and the other forces are one. Spacetime is a quantum foam with no stable geometry; time itself is not yet meaningful.

epochs.name: Grand unification
epochs.summary: Gravity decouples from the unified force. A first arrow of time appears as the young cosmos begins to cool.

epochs.name: Inflation
epochs.summary: Space expands by a factor of 10^26 in a fraction of a second. Quantum fluctuations are stretched into the seeds of every galaxy that will ever exist.

epochs.name: Electroweak epoch
epochs.summary: The strong force separates. Particles acquire mass through the Higgs field as symmetry breaks.

epochs.name: Quark epoch
epochs.summary: Quarks, leptons and gluons move freely. Matter and antimatter annihilate in a faintly lopsided contest.

epochs.name: Hadron epoch
epochs.summary: Quarks bind into protons and neutrons. The surviving matter/antimatter asymmetry freezes in at roughly one baryon per billion photons.

epochs.name: Lepton epoch
epochs.summary: Neutrinos decouple and stream away. Electrons and positrons annihilate, leaving the lepton budget that will feed the first atoms.

epochs.name: Nucleosynthesis
epochs.summary: Primordial fusion forges hydrogen, helium and a trace of lithium. The elemental recipe of the cosmos is set within minutes.

epochs.name: Recombination
epochs.summary: Electrons finally bind to nuclei. The fog clears, photons stream free, and the cosmic microwave background is released.

epochs.name: Dark ages
epochs.summary: Neutral hydrogen fills a lightless, cooling cosmos. Gravity quietly assembles the first filaments of structure.

epochs.name: Reionization
epochs.summary: The first stars ignite, then die, reionizing the intergalactic medium. The universe becomes visible to itself.

big_bang.narrative: A fluctuation in nothingness becomes the seed of every possible history. What follows is not one universe but a family of them.

universes.name: Vexis
universes.narrative: Vexis is a marginal branch 0 generations from the Big Bang. Constants run wild here: entropy 1.263. It has 2 large spatial dimensions. Given roughly 12.90 Gyr of history, it holds 5 notable worlds and expands toward a big crunch.
